description: This file implements a React component for managing and displaying a tasks dashboard, including CRUD operations with optimistic UI updates, filtering, and user interaction.

methods.name: tempId
methods.description: Generates a temporary unique ID for optimistic task creation.

methods.name: statusLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for a given task status.

methods.name: statusTone
methods.description: Returns a tone indicator based on task status for UI styling.

methods.name: priorityTone
methods.description: Returns a tone indicator based on task priority for UI styling.

methods.name: nextStatus
methods.description: Computes the next status in the task lifecycle.

methods.name: matchTask
methods.description: Filters tasks based on search query matching title, description, status, or priority.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of tasks from the API and handles loading/error states.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles creating a new task with optimistic UI update and error handling.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing task with optimistic UI update, concurrency handling, and error recovery.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles task deletion with optimistic removal and error handling.
